name: link-deck
title: Link Deck
description: Fast domain & path launcher for links and commands
author: testycool

commands.name: add-shortcut
commands.title: Add to Deck
commands.description: Save a new link or command

preferences.name: terminal
preferences.title: Terminal Emulator
preferences.description: Command to launch terminal for shell commands (e.g. x-terminal-emulator, alacritty, kitty)

preferences.name: browser
preferences.title: Custom Browser Command
preferences.description: Leave empty for system default (xdg-open), or specify google-chrome, firefox, etc.

scripts.build: bun build src/browse-shortcuts.tsx --outfile browse-shortcuts.js --target node --format cjs --external react --external @vicinae/api --production && bun build src/add-shortcut.tsx --outfile add-shortcut.js --target node --format cjs --external react --external @vicinae/api --production
